newsitem.title: UK: Highland sees strong export market.
newsitem.headline: Highland sees strong export market.

text.p: Whisky producer Highland Distilleries Company Plc said on Monday that its export growth was outstripping the industry average.
The company noted a particularly strong performance in Europe and believes the introduction of its deluxe Famous Grouse Gold Reserve brand should boost its presence in Asia.
Export sales of the Famous Grouse rose five percent overall and 13 percent in Europe in the year to end-August.
It said the UK remained a very competitive market but there were indications that prices were moving up and that its policy of brand building should generate growth.
The UK market for Scotch whisky fell by four percent despite a reduction in excise duty. However, The Famous Grouse increased its market share from 13 percent to 13.3 percent.
The company's pre-tax profit for the year to Aug 31, 1996 fell by 14 percent to 37.1 million stg from 42.9 million.
The decline was the result of higher interest charges and one-off costs relating to the acquisition of the Macallan-Glenlivet whisky company in August.
Highland said synergies and cost savings worth an annual 1.5 million stg had been identified at Macallan.
